content.label: I like this app, overall nice concept and interface but not all of my goals are a binary yes/no outcome. Would be nice to track goals that are performance based, where I could enter an number and the chart will reflect performance relative to the goal figure, above target would be more saturated below target lower color saturation (ie audit 10 customers per day, input is actual # audited could be > or < goal)

If you’re looking to change your life, “atomic habits” style, then you need this app. Not the other habit trackers.. you need this one. This one right here is the best. 

I honestly can’t remember what the free version is like because I saw the value of upgrading within a week of downloading.

I’ve added HabitKit widgets all across my phone and not only have I see my productivity increase, but my lifestyle and mindset have greatly benefited from using this app. 

If Apple were to release a habit tracking app, it wouldn’t compare to this one. It’s sleek, easily customizable, and it’s just an overall better application compared to other habit trackers on the App Store.

If you’re NOT a fan of subscription based services, then THIS IS THE APP FOR YOU. I made a one time payment and this developer has continued to push out updates with an increasing attention to detail. The developer has helped me troubleshoot and they might even incorporate some of my feedback within future updates. 

If you’re hesitant to buy their product, then think of it this way. Apple wants you to subscribe to their iCloud service indefinitely and the developer of this app only wants a one-time contribution from you. That’s it. You’re not renting this product, it is yours to keep. You receive all the future benefits without a monthly/yearly recurring charge to your bank.
Love the app so far, super aesthetic and easy to use!

Finally found a habit app that is simple and intuitive to use. It would be nice if there’s an option to add a note to an entry on any given day. And maybe a free trial period so users can decide if they would like to subscribe. But I love how easy it is to set up and record entries, unlike most other habit tracking apps

name.label: C a p r i c e

title.label: Beautiful. Functional. And I love the stats!

content.label: This app is not only attractive, but very functional and easy to use. I’m a person who loves reviewing stats.  I look forward to any new feature additions. Good job. Thanx for building. It’s what I need.
Thank you and please keep up the great work!

I really like the app, but I didn’t realize until subscribing to pro and adding in lots of habits that it is only set up for daily habits. Being able to schedule habit frequency of twice a week, or schedule for certain days, is a significant element in most habit apps, and it’s really important to me. I don’t want to do 100 habits daily. 

The categories are great… more like tags. Good that you can have multiple, so you can tag as “health” but also tag as “AM Routine” in order to habit stack.
I like the widgets

This is exactly what I’ve been looking for in a habit tracker. Extremely customizable yet simple. There aren’t intrusive blogs or self help notes. It’s just a straight up habit tracking app that is heatmap based. 

Basing the entire app around a heatmap is such a great idea. Every habit has a simple Birds Eye view of its completion history.

Finally the project is owned by a single creator who works hard to put out features. He has a vision for his app and he responds to feature request promptly.

title.label: The perfect app for my needs

content.label: I’ve looked at a lot of apps for this kind of thing and this one is by far the best! So many are either overly complicated (integrating into broader productivity culture) or just not intuitive and straightforward for the most basic function (I did this thing today). Can’t recommend enough.

I like tracking with pen + paper but this app is too good not to use! I don’t always carry my journal to track my daily habits, so it is very convenient to have this HabitKit by my side. As a data lover, I enjoy being able to see the total amount of completed habits on set year. Always good to support, especially if the product delivers!!
Лучшее, что я встречал из трекеров привычек!
Well designed and helpful.

I’ve tried to get into habit tracking with other apps but none of them are as intuitive as this one. Habitkit is so easy to set up and edit if you decide you want to change the habit you want to track and/or its frequency. The app developer is super responsive as well, so you don’t have to worry that you’re going to be stuck in a frustrating email chain with AI bots. If you’re getting into productivity and goal tracking, this is the app to get!

title.label: Practical and helpful even in free mode

content.label: I love habit kit, it’s practical and offers a great free version as well as a paid version, and there’s even an option to pay once and gain the premium version for life!

title.label: Great Simple App, Great Developer, Some Limitations

content.label:
I really love how simple and easy this app is to use. The pricing is also extremely reasonable for $0.99 when most apps charge way more just for some basic functions. I think it would be great if we would were able to create our own account so we can sync progress across different devices. 

I have ADHD and this app really helps me stay motivated and manage my executive dysfunction because I have to gamify EVERYTHING just to do simple things. I like how we are able to select different days for when we want to track a habit, but I wish we could select different reminder times for different days as well under the same habit. Say you want to add a yoga habit for each day, but want reminders at 2:00pm on certain days and 3:00pm on other days for those with varying schedules.

 I also think sub-habit/task would be an interesting game changer. Say you’re trying to incorporate an entire morning routine habit, you can just label the habit morning routine, and you can click it to open, add a sub-habit/task, like make bed, brush teeth, do skin care, and once you check off all three of those things, it will complete that habit for the day. I feel like this would help with lessening the amount of habits you have to make when one habit can incorporate many things you want to do!
Simple & not over complicated! Great balance to easily track habits

title.label: Just what I was looking for

content.label: I was looking for a streak tracking habit app, and I've found it right here. Minimalistic and visually appealing - lets you focus on things that matter - your habits. Another plus is that developer is very responsive, I've sent him an email with a small suggestion and he replied almost immediately.

This is an awesome app to track your daily habits however the main reason I bought the app, the widgets, are finicky. When a new day happens, I have to open the application for the widgets to show up as incomplete. Also for the checkbox widget it would be so nice to have the ability to “complete” the habit by clicking the small check mark. If both of these were addressed it would be 5 stars easily.

UPDATE: the developer of this app is amazing and actually implemented the only two things about the app I wished were true. 5 stars, amazing app and worth the one time purchase price to unlock widgets.

title.label: Great app, could use some work.

content.label: Amazing best habit tracker out there but would be better if it had syncing. I still use it tho.
Finally added interactivity with the widgets. Thanks, highly recommend.

This is a great app. Good pricing. Amazing user experience, apart from the lack of multi-device syncing. Everything is customizable and the grid streaking really helps me keep habits. 100% sucess rate with this as opposed to other apps. 

HabitKit is simple and sleek. Must have for anyone using digital planners or habit trackers.

The app still works as advertised and is wonderful, but now the widgets on my Home Screen change colors with the time of day and seemingly that can’t be changed. The theme in app can be changed but my widgets now stick out like a sore thumb against my background for half the day. Can we revert to the old update?

And that’s a good thing. This app is so much better than what’s out there because it doesn’t try to outsmart itself. Just press a button and you’re done. The addiction comes from wanting to paint the whole heatmap with your habit streak, and it works. I’m on a roll. Probably upgrading to paid soon for widget feature.

title.label: First review for a habit tracker app i actually use

content.label:
Obsessed with the app and the new version. Thank you for your work! 
One question - Is the Apple Watch version on the roadmap anytime soon? Looking forward to being able to log habits on my wrist. Many thanks!

title.label: great app and fast response from developer

content.label: The simple interface and minimalist design of this app really help motivate me to actually use it, and it's easy to see your progress at a glance. I also had an issue with the widgets that was resolved within an hour of contacting the developer! Would recommend.

title.label: Fantastic Habit Tracker from a Responsive Developer

content.label:
The app is an intuitive, visually pleasing way to track your habits. It does a great job of allowing users to customize their habits while not crowding the ui or creating a convoluted user experience. Overall, it is a near-perfect habit tracker with a nice minimalist aesthetic

Also, the developer shows a lot of respect for the users of the app. I wrote to them regarding some functionality that I was hoping they would add and they quickly wrote back to let me know they were working on that. A couple months later they reached out to let me know they were rolling out that feature! In my experience, it is hard to find a developer that is so genuinely responsive to user feedback

Lastly, the app, which does have a premium option, makes the non-premium version actually worthwhile to use and offers the premium version via both subscription and one-time-purchase. Both of those are big pluses in my book!

title.label: So far this app is GREAT!

content.label:
What I would like to see out of this app is widgets compatible with the Lock Screen. The point of getting into a habit is to have it in your face to remind you all the time! Please support Lock Screen widgets. Please :) 

The app otherwise is very good and a small price to pay for a better life.
This is awesome! Thank you for such a great app! I bought full subscription for this! Please make it better and better!

title.label: This the 1 I was looking for

content.label: I have been searching for this exact no frills UX over the past few years & was surprised no 1 made 1. Thank you!!

Tried so many habit tracking apps. And there are a lot of great ones out there but this is probably my favorite. I like the inutitve ui, simple easy to use which keeps me coming back. The set up is prob gonna take the longest and the fight for myself in many apps. But this one its easy, once set up i keep adding new ones as needed. 

Add more widget sizes, possibly customization options is the only thing i ask for so hopefully thats in the future roadmap. As i like to see more than one habit without launching full app. 

Thank you for the awesome app, i swear. This has been godsend.

I love the simple design and color scheme. It works very well for me as a habit tracker.

I have two gripes at the moment. The first is this: I wish you could tap on the check-mark in the home screen widget at it would just mark the habit as complete, instead of opening up the app for you to mark it yourself. I don’t know if this is an iPhone limitation, or user error, or what, but it would be nice

The second is that it costs money. I think it’s a reasonable enough price to pay, but it’s a little shady that you market the app as free, when the features that make it useful are locked behind a paywall. Just sell the app for that amount on the App Store. Or better yet, let it be free. I don’t see what costs you are incurring providing this excellent service to your fellow men.

That being said, I paid for it, and so far it has been worth the cost.
This is the best habit tracker app I’ve used. Download it now, give it a try before deciding what you think about it.
Super easy to use and keeps me on track with the daily habits that I am trying to make a part of my routine.

I love this app; it’s so clean and simple! The free version has up to four habits you can track, which I think is just the right amount for me personally, but for the quality of the app it’s definitely worth purchasing different plans based on your needs.
Thank you for the opportunity of using the Belarusian language!!!
I love this app. Looks great, worlds great … simply amazing ;)

It’s like a portable, phone version of my bullet journal habit tracker visual, so that I can keep an accounting for my physical copy when I review. I also love that it doesn’t have lots of notifications, and I can see the year at a glance.
As an adhd adult, this tracker really helps me by its colored point and it’s such a journaling tool but simple enough for adhders.

You can easily track your habits and streaks!

I love this app! Love the feeling of checking things off a list & this app gives me that same satisfaction in helping me create healthy habits. Love the design & would recommend this app to anyone. Keep it up!
The best habit tracker by far! So simple and elegant - beautifully designed and thought through!

As someone who has always struggled with maintaining consistency in my daily habits, I have tried numerous habit tracking apps in the past. However, none of them have managed to motivate and engage me as much as HabitKit! This app has completely transformed my approach to habit tracking and has helped me build lasting habits that I can finally stick to.

The daily notifications are a gentle but effective reminder to complete my habits, making it nearly impossible to forget or procrastinate. The best part, though, is the GitHub contribution-style chart that visually represents my progress. This brilliant feature has turned habit tracking into an exciting game, where I eagerly work to maintain my streak and fill in the chart.

The interface is clean, intuitive, and user-friendly, allowing me to easily add, edit, and manage my habits. The customization options are also impressive, enabling me to tailor the notifications and chart according to my preferences.

HabitKit has not only helped me stay consistent in my daily routines but has also significantly improved my productivity and overall well-being. I am genuinely grateful for this app and highly recommend it to anyone looking to build and maintain healthy habits. Give HabitKit a try, and I promise you won't be disappointed!
